summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 4 to its Loan and Servicing Agreement, dated July 24, 2026. The amendment extends the facility tenor to five years and the revolving period to three years from the amendment date. The fund acts as equity holder and servicer, with its wholly-owned subsidiary as borrower; Societe Generale is agent. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms, prices, or strategic actions are involved. What to watch: none; this is administrative facility maintenance.
